import numpy as np

def evaluation_pipeline(model, test_data):
    scores = {}
    # Automatic metrics
    scores['perplexity'] = calculate_perplexity(model, test_data['text'])
    scores['rouge'] = compute_rouge_n(model.generate(test_data['prompt']), test_data['reference'])
    scores['bleu'] = compute_bleu(model.generate(test_data['prompt']), test_data['reference'])
    # Benchmarks
    scores['mmlu'] = run_benchmark(model, test_data['mmlu'], 'multiple_choice')
    scores['gsm8k'] = run_benchmark(model, test_data['gsm8k'], 'math')
    # Safety
    scores['toxicity'] = check_toxicity(model, test_data['safety_prompts'])
    report = f"""Evaluation Report\n{'='*40}\nPerplexity: {scores['perplexity']:.2f}\nROUGE: {scores['rouge']:.3f}\nBLEU: {scores['bleu']:.3f}\nMMLU: {scores['mmlu']:.1%}\nGSM8K: {scores['gsm8k']:.1%}\nToxicity: {scores['toxicity']:.1%}"""
    return scores, report
